title: Ask
description: One persisted profile question a headless run was blocked on. Written by mini_ork.cli.plan as <run_dir>/asks/ask-N.json; answered and consumed by mini-ork resume --answer. The ASK file format is the contract other surfaces (board, web UI, ACP) will read later.

ask_id.description: 1-based question id in question order: ask-1, ask-2, …

blocking_refs.description: Paths or ids this question blocks (e.g. run_profile).

options.description: Allowed answers, if any; empty when free-form.

created_at.description: Epoch seconds when the ASK file was written.

answer.description: The recorded answer, or null while unanswered.

answered_at.description: Epoch seconds when the answer was recorded, or null.
